A '''skeleton''' in [[Matcha Flavoured]] has about half the health it has in vanilla ''Minecraft'', but on Normal and Hard it carries a bow with Punch that knocks players back further. Skeletons drop {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}}, and only drop anything when killed by a player.

== Spawning ==
Skeletons use the vanilla biome spawn lists. As undead, they can spawn on the open surface until the [[Ender Dragon]] is killed; see [[Spawning]] and [[Surface]]. Skeletons also come from [[spawner|spawners]] in monster rooms and [[Abbey|abbeys]]; those skeletons drop nothing.

== Drops ==
{{Data/Loot/minecraft/entities/skeleton}}
All drops require a player kill, and skeletons from the pack's spawners drop nothing.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/skeleton.json}}</ref> The arrows and bones are as in vanilla. The pack adds {{ItemLink|Estus Ash}} (0–1). On Normal and Hard, skeletons don't drop the bow they carry. The pack means to stop them dropping other equipment too, but a bug stops this from working reliably; see [[Spawning#Mob modifications]].

== Behavior ==
On Normal and Hard, a skeleton's bow is replaced with a bow enchanted with Punch I (Normal) or Punch II (Hard), with a 0% drop chance.<ref name="n">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/normal_modifications/modify_skeletons.mcfunction}}</ref><ref name="h">{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/spawn_mechanic/hard_modifications/modify_skeletons.mcfunction}}</ref> The new bow replaces any enchantments the skeleton spawned with. These changes apply to every mob in the <code>#minecraft:skeletons</code> tag that the pack checks: skeletons, [[Stray|strays]], [[Bogged|bogged]] and parched.

Skeletons are undead, so [[warding]] hurts them.

== History ==
{{History|

{{History line|1.10|Difficulty support: skeletons have half health on Normal and a little more than half on Hard. Obol drop rate lowered to match other mobs.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Fixed performance problems from skeletons having both Punch I and Punch II. Obols no longer drop from undead.}}

}}
